youtube.aciklama: The 2017 guideline of the American Academy of Otolaryngology does not advise routine head or postural restrictions after a posterior canal maneuver and recommends reassessment within about a month of initial treatment. The maneuver is done in suitable patients by an authorized, trained clinician.
